# Motion & Animation

Motion tokens, vendored animation runtimes for the static gallery, and React animation libraries for product apps.

<a id="gsap-lib"></a>
### GSAP (+ ScrollTrigger)

`https://gsap.com` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build, Polish & QA

Timeline and path-drawing engine. Vendored under GreenSock standard no-charge license.

**Use when**
- Complex hero sequences, SVG path draw-ins, multi-step timelines

**Avoid when**
- Simple KPI count-ups (use Motion or CSS)
- Club GSAP plugins not vendored

**How to use**
- Load ../_vendor/gsap@3.13.0/gsap.min.js and ScrollTrigger.min.js
- Read LICENSE.txt; do not use a CDN in the gallery

**Pairs with:** [Motion (motion.dev)](motion.md#motion-lib) · [Reduced Motion](polish.md#reduced-motion)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/09-motion-system.md](../../docs/design/09-motion-system.md)

**Docs:** https://gsap.com

<a id="motion-lib"></a>
### Motion (motion.dev)

`https://motion.dev` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build, Polish & QA

MIT animation library. Vanilla build vendored for the gallery; React build for product apps.

**Use when**
- Count-ups, staggered card entrances, spring presses, scroll/inView reveals in gallery dashboards
- React product apps that need layout animations

**Avoid when**
- Simple color/opacity hovers (use CSS tokens)
- Anything that must work with zero JS beyond frame.js

**How to use**
- Gallery: load site/dashboards/_vendor/motion@12.23.12/motion.js (relative path, no CDN)
- Follow docs/design/09-motion-system.md; honor prefers-reduced-motion and DB.onVisible
- React apps: npm install motion

**Pairs with:** [Reduced Motion](polish.md#reduced-motion) · [Frontend UI Engineering](build.md#frontend-ui-engineering)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/09-motion-system.md](../../docs/design/09-motion-system.md)

**Docs:** https://motion.dev

---

<a id="dotlottie-web"></a>
### dotLottie web player

`https://lottiefiles.com/dotlottie` · library · **optional** · phases: Build, Polish & QA

Plays .lottie/.json icon animations. Only ship files whose license allows reuse.

**Use when**
- Animated icons or illustrations that need more than CSS

**Avoid when**
- Decorative loops that never stop
- Files without a clear free/reuse license

**How to use**
- Vendor the player under _vendor when first needed
- Store animation files in the dashboard folder; credit in source.credits

**Pairs with:** [Motion (motion.dev)](motion.md#motion-lib) · [Reduced Motion](polish.md#reduced-motion)
